title: Compressed Permutation Oracles Revisited
summary: The compressed permutation oracle has been used to analyze the quantum security of a number of cryptographic constructions which resisted prior techniques. However, these analyses were fundamentally limited by the poor soundness of the method: the technique was proven sound only up to $O(N^{1/12})$ queries to permutations on $N$ elements. We revisit this analysis, improving the soundness bound to a tight $Ω(N^{1/2})$.
